name: Interest Payment Response V 05
definition: Scope|The InterestPaymentResponse message is sent by either;|- the collateral taker or its collateral manager to the collateral giver or its collateral manager, or|- the collateral giver or its collateral manager to the collateral taker or its collateral manager|This is a response to the InterestPaymentRequest message and the amount of interest requested or advised can be accepted or rejected.||The message definition is intended for use with the ISO20022 Business Application Header.||Usage|The InterestPaymentResponse message is sent in response to the InterestPaymentRequest in order to accept or reject the amount of interest requested or advised. A rejection reason and information can be provide if the InterestPaymentRequest is being rejected.

TransactionIdentification.name: Transaction Identification
TransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as know by the instructing party.

Obligation.name: Obligation
Obligation.definition: Provides information like the identification of the party or parties associated with the collateral agreement, the exposure type and the valuation date.

Agreement.name: Agreement
Agreement.definition: Agreement details for the over the counter market.

InterestDueToA.name: Interest Due To A
InterestDueToA.definition: Provides details on the interest amount due to party A.

InterestDueToB.name: Interest Due To B
InterestDueToB.definition: Provides details on the interest amount due to party B.

InterestResponse.name: Interest Response
InterestResponse.definition: Provides details on the response to the interest payment request.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that can not be captured in the structured fields and/or any other specific block.
